commentary.text: 90+11' The referee blows for the end of today's match.

90+10' Georginio Rutter (Brighton) attempts to convert a cross into a goal, but his promising header from near the penalty spot towards the roof of the net is denied by a decent save from Djordje Petrovic.
90+9' Substitution. Alejandro Jimenez will be replaced by Veljko Milosavljevic (Bournemouth).
90+4' Adrien Truffert (Bournemouth) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
90+3' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) heads on.

90+1' 1 - 1 What a GOAL that is! Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) showed great determination to get to the ball inside the box and acrobatically launched himself into the air and produced a scissor kick of the highest quality to leave Djordje Petrovic helpless. He makes it 1:1.
90' There will be a minimum of 8 min. of added time.
89' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ferdi Kadioglu trots off the pitch and is replaced by Olivier Boscagli (Brighton).
89' A quickly taken corner by Brighton.
85' Djordje Petrovic (Bournemouth) receives a yellow card for infringement.
85' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) is first to the rebound inside the box but sends his effort high over the bar.
84' The resulting set piece from Brighton is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

84' A big opportunity is wasted by Yankuba Minteh (Brighton), who makes a yard for himself and produces a mid-range rocket of a shot towards the roof of the net. Unfortunately for him, Djordje Petrovic pulls off a fantastic save to stop the effort. The ball is out of play. Brighton win a corner kick.
83' Adam Smith (Bournemouth) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
83' The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Brighton.
82' Joel Veltman (Brighton) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players.
82' Pascal Gross (Brighton) sends the corner into the box, but Djordje Petrovic intercepts it and averts the threat.
82' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
80' Bournemouth take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
79' Problems for Andoni Iraola as Amine Adli is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Bafode Diakite (Bournemouth) replaces him.
78' Fabian Hurzeler has decided to make a change. Charalampos Kostoulas (Brighton) replaces Danny Welbeck.
78' Jan Paul van Hecke (Brighton) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
77' Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
75' The possession of the ball – 64:36.
73' Brighton can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
72' Andoni Iraola has decided to substitute Eli Junior Kroupi and he is replaced by Ryan Christie (Bournemouth).
71' Adam Smith comes onto the pitch after Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) signals to the bench that he cannot continue any longer after picking up an injury.
70' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.

70' Pascal Gross (Brighton) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. The referee points to the corner flag and Brighton will take a corner.
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Georginio Rutter (Brighton) comes onto the pitch so that Diego Gomez can be given a rest.
66' Fabian Hurzeler prepares a substitution. Jack Hinshelwood is replaced by Carlos Baleba (Brighton).
66' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Yankuba Minteh (Brighton) will replace Brajan Gruda.
64' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
60' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Marcos Senesi (Bournemouth) was quite harsh and Paul Tierney didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
58' Danny Welbeck (Brighton) is booked.
58' A pass from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is intercepted by Djordje Petrovic and the move breaks down.
56' The corner is swung in but Brighton can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
55' The referee awards a corner and Pascal Gross (Brighton) goes over to take it.
53' Alex Scott (Bournemouth) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
52' The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Bournemouth will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
49' Kaoru Mitoma (Brighton) places a shot at goal from the edge of the box that bends just wide of the right post.
48' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+6' Paul Tierney blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+1' Evanilson (Bournemouth) climbs all over the defender near the penalty spot to win the ball from a cross by Adrien Truffert, but plants his header narrowly wide of the right post.
45' 5 additional min. will be played.
44' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) sends in a lofted cross from a mid-range free kick. His effort, however, goes out of play.
43' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) brings an opponent down and Paul Tierney interrupts the game. Brighton are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
42' The current number of fouls conceded by both teams is 4:1.
39' What a chance that is! Evanilson (Bournemouth) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the left post!
37' A great run from Evanilson (Bournemouth) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the left post.

35' What a great chance for Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton). He times his jump superbly when he leaps high to meet a precise cross from the corner, directing his towering header inside the right post, but the goalkeeper denies him with a miraculous save.
35' There's an opportunity for Pascal Gross (Brighton) to deliver the ball into the box from a corner.
32' 0 - 1 Goal! Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Bart Verbruggen into the bottom left corner.
32' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
31' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Bournemouth!
31' Amine Adli (Bournemouth) looks relieved after the referee decides on no action against him after the VAR review.
29' Referee Paul Tierney makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Bournemouth. Let’s see what happens!
27' The expression of the referee Paul Tierney is crystal clear. This behaviour won't be tolerated. Amine Adli (Bournemouth) is shown a yellow card.
27' One of the Bournemouth players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
26' The resulting corner from Pascal Gross (Brighton) is cleared by the opposition's defence.
23' Lewis Cook (Bournemouth) swings in the corner, but the goalkeeper does a brilliant job to intercept the effort.
21' Alejandro Jimenez (Bournemouth) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
18' Bart Verbruggen leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth).
17' Bournemouth work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.
15' Evanilson (Bournemouth) darts into the penalty area to latch on to a pass, and he unleashes a shot in the direction of the right post. Bart Verbruggen is alert and denies him with a nice save.
14' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Alex Scott (Bournemouth) inside the box following a slide rule pass.
13' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
13' Bournemouth take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
10' Evanilson (Bournemouth) times his run too early and the linesman raises his flag for offside.
9' Brajan Gruda (Brighton) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round!
8' Pascal Gross (Brighton) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
8' Jack Hinshelwood (Brighton) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender. It will be a corner kick for Brighton.
4' Ferdi Kadioglu (Brighton) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and fires in a shot that heads towards the middle of the goal, but Djordje Petrovic makes a comfortable save.
2' Marcus Tavernier (Bournemouth) seems to have picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue playing.
